You have Lockjaw. Lockjaw — bacteria from rust and dirt, settled into a wound. Without real treatment it kills. Antibiotics end it; skilled wound care (triage, field medicine) can turn it — but only if you know what you're treating. (Antibiotics would end it.) The ruins to the east sometimes still hold medicine cabinets — worth searching. — diagnosed by Remya.
